**Introduction to Horsehead Corporation**

Horsehead Corporation, headquartered at **300 Frankfort Road, Monaca, PA 15061-2295**, was a leading **specialty metals and chemicals company** with a strong legacy in **zinc production, recycling, and environmental sustainability**. Founded in **1999** as a spin-off from **Zinc Corporation of America**, Horsehead became a key player in the **zinc and zinc-based chemicals industry**, serving diverse sectors such as **steel galvanizing, agriculture, rubber manufacturing, and construction**.

The company operated one of the **largest zinc smelters in North America** at its Monaca facility, utilizing **advanced recycling technologies** to recover zinc from **electric arc furnace (EAF) dust**—a byproduct of steel production. This innovative approach not only reduced waste but also positioned Horsehead as a **sustainable leader** in metal recovery. The Monaca plant was a cornerstone of the company’s operations, producing **high-purity zinc metal, zinc oxide, and other specialty chemicals** used in **batteries, coatings, and industrial applications**.

Horsehead was also known for its commitment to **environmental stewardship**, implementing **closed-loop recycling processes** to minimize emissions and waste. The company’s **EcoServices division** further expanded its capabilities in **hazardous waste management and metal reclamation**, reinforcing its role in the **circular economy**.

In **2016**, Horsehead Corporation was acquired by **American Zinc Recycling (AZR)**, a subsidiary of **Sun Capital Partners**, which continued its operations under a new structure. Despite the transition, Horsehead’s **technological innovations and sustainability initiatives** remain influential in the **metals and chemicals industry**, leaving a lasting impact on **recycling, manufacturing, and environmental practices**.

Today, the **Monaca facility** continues to operate as a critical hub for **zinc production and recycling**, upholding the legacy of Horsehead Corporation while driving advancements in **sustainable metal processing**.
